lesson: The short entry failed due to a lack of confirmation on the lower timeframe, as the price reclaimed the EMA50 instead of respecting it as resistance. The system correctly identified the macro downtrend but ignored the potential for a Wyckoff spring or liquidity sweep before the continuation.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 15m timeframe before entering short positions in a downtrend to avoid front-running liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps more than EMA trend-following on ADAUSDT.
